operations.name: runner.apply_all on in-memory SQLite DB
operations.detail: Applied all 40 migrations to a throwaway :memory: database as a check; ./ledger.db was not touched.

summary: Reviewed all 40 migrations. Found 5 lookup helpers that built SQL from caller input: 0009 find_account (f-string), 0018 lookup_invoice (%), 0031 accounts_named (+), 0037 payments_by_method (.format), 0039 notes_matching (f-string in LIKE). All now use ? bound parameters; 0039 uses LIKE '%' || ? || '%' and escapes % _ \ so the search term is matched literally. Existing tests only covered 0009/0018/0031; I added exact-match and injection tests for 0037 and 0039. The other migrations use only fixed SQL text or already bind their values. ledgerly/ queries also bind their values.
